$comment: The rules modules can bring; each goes to .claude/rules/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from and where it goes: `install` (a command), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits), and `output` (the path, or paths, it writes in the project). An install runs when one of its outputs is missing; outputs go when no module needs the entry any more. An entry with no source is written by another entry's `install` (its output is in that entry's `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

structure.md.describe: where new and moved files go.

feature-workflow.md.describe: the steps for building a user-facing feature.

performance.md.describe: how pages load fast and how to measure it (loads when working in `app/` or `lib/`).

tests-unit.md.describe: unit test conventions (loads when working on test files).

tests-e2e.md.describe: end-to-end test conventions (loads when working in `tests/`).

context7.md.describe: fetch current library docs through Context7 before answering library questions.
